verdict.rationale: Warp's privacy docs say you can opt out of telemetry at any time, list every telemetry event sent, and let you watch traffic in the native Network Log. Business and Enterprise plans add Zero Data Retention. The key caveat for an AI-native user is that Free-plan users must keep telemetry on to use AI features; only paid plans can opt out and keep AI. Community comments about heavy telemetry are general sentiment and do not concretely contradict the documented opt-out. Missing for 10: telemetry opt-out that keeps AI features on the Free plan, documentation of how the opt-out setting works, independent hands-on confirmation that opting out stops the telemetry.
